lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 complete. Critical byte-vs-char bug in parseBatchOutput fixed: git cat-file --batch reports <size> in BYTES, but the old implementation sliced the UTF-8-decoded stdout STRING by character count. Fix: convert the decoded string to a Buffer with Buffer.from(str, 'utf8') then use Buffer.subarray/Buffer.indexOf for byte-accurate framing. Added 3 unit tests with accented Portuguese content (migração, ação, cancelação) to test/issues/backlog.test.ts and 1 real-git integration test (AC#5) to test/integration/issue-dir-real-git.test.ts. All 2060 tests pass. Empirical: the real 129-issue backlog was returning only 91 entries (38 dropped); now returns all 129. The PRD is now a review-round PRD with US-R1-001 as the only review-fix story; all original US-001..US-010 already passed. No remaining passes:false stories.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: git cat-file --batch <size> field is the object size IN BYTES (not characters). Header: '<oid> SP <type> SP <size> LF', then exactly <size> bytes of content, then LF. Fix is correct: Buffer-based byte slicing matches the documented byte-count contract.
